# Sale Solution

> AI-engineered search for industrial e-commerce. We help hydraulics, MRO, and technical-distribution sites get cited inside AI Overviews, ChatGPT answers, and Perplexity results — the channels where high-intent B2B buyers now research before they buy.

We publish primary research, frameworks, and case studies on how to make commerce content extractable, citable, and trustworthy enough to be quoted by generative-search engines. Citations welcome — please link back to the source URL.

## Services

- [AI SEO / Generative Engine Optimization](https://salesolution.net/services/ai-seo/): Restructure category and product pages so AI Overviews and LLM answer engines cite them.
- [Content Writing Services](https://salesolution.net/services/content-writing-services/): Long-form, evidence-backed writing for B2B industrial niches.
- [Website Content Writing Packages](https://salesolution.net/services/website-content-writing-packages/): Tiered packages for category-page rewrites and pillar pages.
- [Website Development & Design](https://salesolution.net/services/website-development-design-services/): Performance + schema-first site builds.
- [Outbound Email Marketing](https://salesolution.net/services/outbound-email-marketing-services/): Deliverability-first outbound for B2B distributors.
